# IME365 DIR-004 — SURFACE 3 MASTER ENGINEERING DIRECTIVE
## Surface 3 Modernization: Full 53KB CreateJobModal Parity, Screening Questions, Candidate Review Drawer & ATS Pipeline

**Directive ID:** DIR-004  
**Priority:** P0 — Critical  
**Surface:** Surface 3 of 5 (Employer Portal & Recruitment Hub)  
**Depends On:** DIR-003 (Unlocks automatically when DIR-003 is certified & frozen)  
**Executive Engineering Lead:** Antigravity (Google DeepMind)  
**Implementation Engine:** Claude Code CLI  

---

### 1. Objective & Scope
Modernize the complete Employer Portal in React 19 / TypeScript / Vite / Tailwind CSS v4 with Cuba M3 executive glassmorphic styling, ensuring 100% functional parity with legacy implementations in `src/`:

1. **Full-Field Job Creation (`CreateJobModal.jsx` Parity — SHORTCUTS STRICTLY PROHIBITED)**:
   - **CRITICAL ANTI-TRUNCATION INVARIANT**: The developer MUST NOT reduce the job creation modal to 4 raw text inputs. Full functional parity with the 53 KB `CreateJobModal.jsx` is mandatory:
     - Job title, department, employment type (Full-time, Part-time, Contract, Internship).
     - Location and Remote / Hybrid / On-site workplace policy toggles.
     - Minimum and maximum salary range with currency selector (USD, EUR, GBP, INR) and pay period (Annual, Monthly, Hourly).
     - Experience level selector (Entry, Mid, Senior, Lead, Executive).
     - Perks and Benefits multi-select pill badges (Health insurance, 401(k), Remote stipend, Equity, Unlimited PTO).
     - **Interactive Custom Screening Questions Builder**: Adding, editing, ordering questions with answer formats (Short text, Yes/No, Multiple Choice, Required/Optional flag).
     - Application deadline date picker.
     - Rich-text job description and responsibilities/requirements editor.
     - Server-side validation and persistence to MariaDB `jobs` table.

2. **Candidate Review Drawer**:
   - Candidate list with search, sorting, and ATS match score pills.
   - Slide-out candidate review drawer with live resume viewer, ATS match breakdown, candidate notes, and rating stars.
   - Candidate rejection/shortlisting actions with confirmation and audit logging.

3. **Applicant Tracking Pipeline (Kanban & List)**:
   - Stage transitions: Applied → Reviewing → Shortlisted → Interview → Hired / Rejected.
   - State refresh, drag-and-drop or dropdown stage progression, and persistent backend sync.

4. **Company Profile & Team Seats**:
   - Company branding assets (logo, banner, description, website, team culture).
   - Direct applicant messaging thread.
   - Team seats, role permissions (Admin, Recruiter, Viewer), and invite workflows.

---

### 2. Invariants
- ZERO CAPABILITY LOSS: Full preservation of CreateJobModal (53 KB) with all fields, screening questions, and backend persistence.
- ZERO FABRICATED DATA: No hardcoded fake candidate profiles or static pipeline counts.
- WCAG 2.1 AA ACCESSIBILITY & Sub-4s build.
invariants: ZERO CAPABILITY LOSS: Full preservation of CreateJobModal (53 KB) with custom screening questions and benefits pills (no 4-field shortcut).

EMPLOYER JOB CREATION CONTRACT: POST /api/employer/jobs MUST send payload nested in { data: { companyId, title, department, location, type, salary, description, requirements, ... } }. Flat parameters without companyId trigger HTTP 400 rejection.

CANDIDATE REQUISITION PIPELINE CONTRACT: Applicants are strictly scoped to job requisitions via GET /api/jobs/:jobId/applications, candidate resumes via GET /api/employer/jobs/:jobId/applications/:applicationId/resume, and status updates via PATCH /api/job-applications/:applicationId/status with { status, notes, expectedStatus, expectedRevision }. Calling flat /api/employer/candidates is prohibited (returns 404).

STATUS TRANSITION STATE MACHINE: PATCH /api/job-applications/:applicationId/status enforces strict transitions (pending -> interview|accepted|rejected; interview -> accepted|rejected|pending; accepted -> interview|rejected; rejected -> pending|interview). Invalid jumps trigger HTTP 400 INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION.

CANDIDATE APPLICATION SUBMISSION CONTRACT: POST /api/jobs/:jobId/applications enforces coverLetter text length 50-1000 characters, phone regex /^\+?[0-9 ()-]{7,30}$/, and returns HTTP 409 ALREADY_APPLIED on duplicates.
OPTIMISTIC CONCURRENCY LOCKING: PATCH /api/employer/jobs/:jobId and DELETE /api/employer/jobs/:jobId MUST pass integer expectedRevision to prevent silent race conditions.

ZERO PHANTOM HOOK REFERENCES: Employer portal (portal.tsx) must not import non-existent hooks (useCandidates, useAdvanceCandidateStage) and must resolve candidate pipeline through real job-application endpoints.
ZERO FABRICATED PRODUCTION DATA: Live API binding for applicants, job posts, and stages.
WCAG 2.1 AA ACCESSIBILITY: Full keyboard accessibility and color contrast.
acceptanceCriteria: Employer dashboard renders within CubaAppShell with job metrics and pipeline overview.
CreateJobModal opens with full fields (screening questions, benefits, salary bands, remote policy), sends payload nested in { data: { companyId, ... } }, and persists to backend MariaDB database.
Candidate review drawer renders real candidate details via GET /api/jobs/:jobId/applications and live resume preview via GET /api/employer/jobs/:jobId/applications/:applicationId/resume.
Candidate stage updates pass { status, notes, expectedStatus, expectedRevision } to PATCH /api/job-applications/:applicationId/status respecting valid state transitions.
Applicant tracking stage progression and job status pauses pass expectedRevision correctly to backend API.
Company profile updates and team seat management verified.
TypeScript check passes with zero errors (tsc -b) with all phantom hook references eliminated in portal.tsx.
Playwright crawl of employer routes passes with zero console errors.
